@@U02937@@
I suspect you never wore a pigtail.
Ah, and today your hair is cut short.
A Swedish cut, as they say.
It makes you look quite manly and resolute;
just don't go home in the “absolute.”

@@U02939@@
Old man—
we may be in the same old place,
but times have changed, remember;
we can do without the double entendres.
I’m not as gullible as I once was.
You had your fun with me back then,
with no great effort; but, then,
I was naive.
That won't happen again.

@@U02941@@
Speak the unvarnished truth to the young
and they squirm in discomfort.
But when years later
they learn from bitter experience,
they flatter themselves
they discovered it on their own,
and there’s no good word
for the poor old idiot of a teacher.

@@U02943@@
Scoundrel, perhaps.
What teacher ever told the truth
straight to our faces?
By contrivance they overstate or understate,
gravely one time, beaming the next,
all very clever,
to their docile, trusting students.

@@U02945@@
There is, of course, a time for learning;
but you, I see, are yourself ready to teach.
translation:
@@U02937@@
我怀疑你从来没有扎过辫子。
啊，今天你的头发剪短了。
正如他们所说，瑞典式剪裁。
它让你看起来很有男子气概和坚决；
只是不要以“绝对”的方式回家。

@@U02939@@
老头——
我们可能还在同一个老地方，
但时代已经变了，记住；
我们可以不用双关语。
我不再像以前那样容易上当受骗了。
当年你陪我玩得很开心
无需付出很大的努力；但是，那么，
我很天真。
那不会再发生了。

@@U02941@@
向年轻人说出不加掩饰的真相
他们不自在地蠕动着。
但当多年以后
他们从痛苦的经历中吸取教训，
他们自吹自擂
他们自己发现的，
并且没有什么好词
对于一个可怜的老白痴老师来说。

@@U02943@@
也许是恶棍。
哪个老师说过真话
直接当着我们的面？
他们故意夸大或低估，
一次严肃，下一次微笑，
都非常聪明，
对他们温顺、信任的学生。

@@U02945@@
当然，也有学习的时间；
但我知道你已经准备好教书了。
